name: 74058 · Pawnee, OK
findings: ZIP 74058 (Pawnee) has 19 nonprofit organizations. 7 of them (37%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 6 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (17% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 74058 (Pawnee) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 74058 (Pawnee) list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 3.7 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 6 organizations here; 53% of all organizations here have no identified type.
